1.problem: A pirate ship spots, 10 nautical miles to the east, an oblivious caravel sailing \(60^\circ\) south of west at a steady 12 nm/hour. What is the minimum speed that the pirate ship must maintain at to be able to catch the caravel?
1.solutions: No official solution was published for this problem.

2.problem: A black witch’s hat is in the classic shape of a cone on top of a circular brim. The cone has a slant height of 18 inches and a base radius of 3 inches. The brim has a radius of 5 inches. What is the total surface area of the hat?
2.solutions: No official solution was published for this problem.

5.problem: Four circles of radius 1 are each tangent to two sides (line segments) of a square and externally tangent to a circle of radius 3. What is the area of the space that is inside the square but not contained in any of the circles?
